author: Alex#6698
title: Disgusting Ad Trick: Shaking Phone = Forced Click?!
content:
This is by far the most revolting and deceptive ad behavior I’ve ever seen in an app. The moment I launch the app, an ad appears, and a slight shake of the phone is treated as a tap?! Are you serious?

This is not user interaction. it’s pure manipulation. I didn’t click anything. I barely moved my phone, and suddenly I’m redirected to some garbage ad page like I meant to engage with it. This is an insult to user intelligence and basic UX principles.

And guess what? Even after paying for a membership, I STILL get these garbage ads. What’s the point of subscribing if you continue shoving this filth in my face?

This isn’t “growth hacking.” This is user betrayal. You’re artificially inflating ad metrics at the cost of trust and integrity. Any company running ads like this should be ashamed. One star. Absolutely disgraceful.
